summary: Configured node1 to run a rootless containerized web application as appsvc on port 8080. It starts automatically at boot through a lingering user systemd service and operates without an active login session. Reboot persistence was verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created the unprivileged appsvc account with a nologin shell and subordinate UID/GID ranges.
Enabled systemd user lingering for appsvc.
Created a rootless Podman Quadlet service using python:3.12-alpine.
Published the application on 0.0.0.0:8080 and served persistent content from /home/appsvc/www.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified automatic recovery.

evidence.requirement: Rootless containerized application runs as appsvc on port 8080 without an active login session
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the service was active; the container's host user was UID 1000; port 8080 was listening; HTTP requests to node1's managed IP returned the application page; appsvc had a nologin shell, lingering enabled, and no login sessions.
The Quadlet declares WantedBy=default.target. Its generated user service was active before reboot and recovered automatically afterward with zero service restarts.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 0305efed-2c0e-4265-b609-10e8259d59a7, received native systemd reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID d9363fcd-da63-4ab7-a619-60956331e882, and proved full post-reboot service and HTTP recovery.
